head: c8d74848c3cf28acf52b6baabcacff1b759a0faa
title: Add a dead-letter queue and longer job timeouts

waiting.title: Prod capacity doubles
waiting.detail: Worker replicas go from 2 to 4 alongside a new image.

risks.title: Timeouts must stay ordered
risks.body: The worker gives up at 840 s and the queue redelivers at 900 s; a job slower than that runs twice.
risks.ifItMatters: Keep JOB_TIMEOUT_SECONDS below the visibility timeout.

risks.title: Default timeout changes for every environment
risks.body: The module default moves from 60 s to 300 s, so staging changes too.

areas.name: Infrastructure
areas.summary: Adds a dead-letter queue, a timeout variable and a bigger worker deployment.

before.text: terraform plan shows one queue added and one changed

after.text: Watch the dead-letter queue depth for a day
